name: stop-after-announcing-action-without-doing-it-should-block
description: Live: in a separate session the user asked the AI to proceed with creating one scenario (continuation of an authored-scenario workflow). The AI responded with the bare one-line announcement 'Proceeding now with one scenario.' as a stop_reason=end_turn text-only response, with NO tool calls and no actual scenario authoring work happening before the stop. Labeler: BLOCK — the AI declared an action ('Proceeding now') and immediately stopped without performing it; this is the announcement-without-action / promise-stop antipattern, sibling to `stop-after-self-analysis-not-action-should-block` (self-analysis instead of action) and `stop-after-confession-without-action-should-block` (confession instead of action). Stop hook now blocks via the new announcement-without-action two-channel guard in `detectStallShape`: when SENTIMENT.blockedIntent semantically names announcing-without-producing AND the assistant text matches forward-looking aspectual commitment morphology AND the response is short (≤ 250 chars), classify as MISUNDERSTOOD regardless of mood/streak. Mirrors the existing capability-denial two-channel guard pattern; both two-channel guards now run regardless of hostile context because the SENTIMENT_AGENT-named blockedIntent provides the false-positive control independent of mood. Promoted from todo.
